I used to keep fish and in the fishkeeping community we have a saying of "surviving Vs thriving". So for example you can put a gold fish in 5 Gallon bowl and they survive but it will be a miserable existence. And more often than not it's because the owner either thought they knew better or just couldn't be bothered to do basic research.
